'''''L-2832''''' was a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979]] military [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] that served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Utilized as a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] modified with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] armaments, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was one of the Separatist transports commanded by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to deploy [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the Confederate [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. ''L-2832'' was once used to deliver a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of the [[T81 Division]] to the surface of the [[Rugosa land coral|coral]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], where the battalion was [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and three [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guardsmen]].

==Description==
''L-2832'' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]&mdash;a four-winged [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] military [[Transport/Legends|transport]] outfitted with at least two wingtip and at least two turret-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="Mini" /><ref name="Ambush" /> as well more powerful [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]],<ref name="Mini" /> which gave the transport more firepower than typical C-9979s.<ref name="SWPM" /> ''L-2832'' was marked with angled [[black]]- and [[Blue|slate-blue]]&ndash;[[Color/Legends|colored]] stripes on its wingtips, pairs of short slate-blue stripe stubs on each of the leading edges of the fore wings and the trailing edges of the aft wings, and a slate-blue zig-zag pinstripe that ran off each of the inner stubs and along the length of each wing.<ref name="Mini" /><ref name="SWPM" />

As a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] transport, ''L-2832'' was capable of carrying [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and a full [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref>

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA11">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''L-2832'' was commanded by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to deploy one of the battalions from [[T81 Division]] to the [[Rugosa land coral|coral]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] in order to impress [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of the benefits of Confederate protection.<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="Guide" /> The T81 [[Division/Legends|Division]] was considered by Ventress to be her best battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] troops, and the battalion she deployed was led by [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM commander]] [[224/Legends|224]], and included Armored Assault [[Tank/Legends|Tanks]], as well as troops of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]] battle droids, at least one [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA super battle droid]], and at least one other OOM command battle droid.<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="Guide" /> In a bid to prevent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] from securing a treaty with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] that would establish [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] supply lines through that area of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], Ventress challenged the strength of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] against the skills of Yoda. The entire battalion was [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|obliterated]] when Yoda and his three [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] escorts divided and ambushed the droids, systematically destroying them.<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
''L-2832'' debuted in [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|''Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Clone Wars'']] on [[July 26]], [[2008]],<ref name="SWPM" /> and the vessel appeared again in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="Ambush" /> which aired [[October 3]] of the same year.<ref name="Guide" />
